data.title: BlackRock (BLK) Files Bitcoin Protection ETF And Launches Active Robotics Fund
data.description: BlackRock (NYSE:BLK) filed for the iShares Bitcoin Managed Protection ETF, a bitcoin-linked fund with a downside protection feature. The filing outlines a structure that targets exposure to bitcoin price moves while using risk management tools to limit losses. BlackRock also introduced an actively managed Robotics ETF that focuses on companies tied to automation and AI-focused hardware and software. The twin launch of a bitcoin-linked protection ETF and a new Robotics ETF deserves weighing...
